posting.title: Senior Data Scientist
posting.description:
About the role:
Helsingoer Kommune Digital is the municipality's in-house analytics unit, building forecasting models for social services, transport, and budget planning. We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to lead statistical modeling work and present findings to city leadership.

Responsibilities:
You will design and maintain forecasting and resource-allocation models using Python and SQL. You will present your findings and recommendations directly to the city council and department heads on a weekly basis.

Requirements:
5+ years of experience with Python, SQL, and statistical modeling is required. Danish is a requirement for this role: you must speak and write fluent Danish, as you will present findings directly to Danish-speaking city council stakeholders every week and no translation support is provided. Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms is a plus.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid, with two days a week in our Helsingoer office.

What we offer:
A stable public-sector role with strong work-life balance and a pension scheme.
